description.value:
You fire a paralyzing dart at a droid or construct you can see within range. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect early on a success.

Overcharge Tech. Casting with a slot of 3rd level or higher lets you target one additional droid or construct—each within 30 feet of the others—for every slot level beyond 2nd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
